characters.summary: Jigglypuff is a lightweight fighter who relies on mobility, aerial control, and its trademark Sing ability to put opponents to sleep. Once an enemy is incapacitated, it can deliver a devastating, high-risk physical counter-attack known as Rest.
weaknesses: Extremely light weight makes it prone to being launched easily
Rest leaves it vulnerable if it misses or fails to KO the target
limitations: Extremely vulnerable to knockback due to feather-light weight
Rest has a long recovery animation if it fails to connect

sources.supports: Abilities like Sing, Rest, Rollout, and its light weight in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate.

feats.claim: Puts nearby opponents to sleep using the Sing technique.
feats.citation: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate gameplay mechanics

feats.claim: Executes a high-risk close-range attack called Rest that launches opponents.
feats.citation: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate gameplay mechanics

campaignTags.claim: Can float and perform multiple mid-air jumps.

unknowns: Exact canonical scaling relative to mainline Pokémon RPG statistics within the crossover fighting context.

characters.summary: Jill Valentine is an elite tactical operative and survivor who utilizes a wide range of firearms, explosives, and quick evasive maneuvers. She excels at ranged combat and improvising solutions against heavily mutated biological threats.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to sustained physical trauma without healing items
limitations: Relies entirely on scavenged ammunition and standard physical endurance
Human physical limits apply to stamina and injury recovery

sources.supports: Her background as an S.T.A.R.S. operative, combat skills, and tactical gear.

feats.claim: Survives encounters and defeats mutated Bio-Weapons such as the Nemesis.

notableResults.note: Utilized environmental hazards and a railgun to achieve victory.

campaignTags.claim: Carries lockpicks, grenades, and tactical survival equipment.

unknowns: Exact long-term physiological effects of her exposure to the T-Virus and subsequent antibody treatment.

characters.summary: Jim Raynor is a seasoned Terran commander and guerrilla fighter who utilizes heavy powered armor, advanced firearms, and tactical infantry support. He commands rebel forces and specializes in ranged combat against overwhelming alien swarms.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to heavy anti-armor weaponry and specialized psychic attacks
Stimpack usage causes temporary physical strain
limitations: Armor can be breached by heavy siege artillery or sustained plasma fire
Ammunition and tactical reinforcement supplies are finite

sources.supports: Details on Raynor's CMC powered armor, gauss rifle, and tactical capabilities.

feats.claim: Leads successful guerrilla campaigns against both the Zerg Swarm and the Terran Dominion.

notableResults.citation: StarCraft II: Heart of the Swarm
notableResults.note: Overthrew the Terran Dominion with allied forces.

campaignTags.claim: Wears a heavy CMC powered combat suit.
Utilizes advanced Terran firearms and tactical tech.

unknowns: Precise durability limits of his custom armor under continuous siege cannon fire.

characters.summary: Jinx is an unpredictable chaotic marksman who employs a vast arsenal of explosive weaponry, rocket launchers, and trap-setting gadgets. She excels at causing widespread devastation from a distance at the cost of close-range defense.

mechanisms: Mobility boosts upon securing kills or assists (Get Excited!)

weaknesses: Prone to emotional volatility affecting tactical focus
limitations: Lacks reliable defensive countermeasures if caught in hand-to-hand combat
Weapon reloading and switching introduce brief openings

sources.supports: Weapons inventory including Fishbones, Pow-Pow, and explosive capabilities.

feats.claim: Destroys buildings and infrastructure with long-range super rockets.

campaignTags.claim: Deploys Flame Chompers and explosive traps.
Uses advanced hextech-modified firearms and explosives.

unknowns: The exact chemical composition and volatile stability of her homemade hextech explosives.

weaknesses: Vulnerable to armed groups and infected hordes
limitations: Subject to normal human injury, fatigue, and mortality
Limited carrying capacity for ammunition and crafting materials

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes stealth takedowns and environmental cover to bypass enemies.

characters.summary: King Dedede is a powerful, heavy-hitting monarch who wields a giant wooden hammer with crushing force. He can also inhale objects, hover using deep breaths, and deploy various mechanical contraptions.
weaknesses: Slow recovery after heavy hammer swings
Arrogance can leave openings for counters
limitations: Heavy weight reduces fast agile dodging on the ground
Hammer can become stuck if swung too hard into solid ground

sources.supports: King Dedede's hammer attacks, inhaling abilities, and durability.

feats.claim: Smashes solid stone pillars and withstands explosive impacts.

campaignTags.claim: Hovers in mid-air by taking deep breaths.

unknowns: The precise metallurgical composition of his signature giant wooden-headed hammer.

characters.summary: Kirby is a pink, spherical hero with the ability to inhale enemies and copy their abilities or transform to match them. He possesses immense latent power, flight capabilities, and physical resilience.
weaknesses: Vulnerable when spitting out an inhaled enemy or losing copy ability after taking damage
limitations: Copy abilities are lost upon taking sufficient damage
Cannot inhale certain colossal or anchored structures

sources.supports: Kirby's core inhale, copy ability, and floating mechanics.

feats.claim: Inhales massive objects and foes much larger than himself.

campaignTags.claim: Inhales air to float indefinitely in the sky.

unknowns: The exact dimensions and physics of his pocket-dimension stomach capacity.

characters.summary: In his Hypernova form, Kirby consumes a Miracle Fruit, granting his Inhale god-like suction strength capable of devouring entire trees, mechanical bosses, and environmental structures.

mechanisms: Overwhelming suction force pushes away incoming projectiles

weaknesses: Form is strictly temporary, dependent on the lingering effects of the Miracle Fruit
characters.formDifferences: Massively amplifies Inhale range and suction strength to planetary or environmental scale, preventing standard copy abilities in favor of consuming massive obstacles.

sources.supports: Hypernova Kirby's extreme suction power granted by the Miracle Fruit.

campaignTags.claim: Retains floating ability while in the Hypernova state.

unknowns: Whether the Miracle Fruit's power has an upper mass limit.

characters.summary: Wielding the legendary Star Rod, Kirby can channel potent star energy to project star-shaped magic blasts directly at adversaries, bypassing normal physical durability.
weaknesses: Relies on holding the Star Rod item to project ranged star beams
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard physical attacks and copy abilities with ranged star projectile attacks channeled directly from the Star Rod.

sources.supports: Star Rod's ability to project star beams and channel dream power.

campaignTags.claim: Can still fly and float while equipped with the Star Rod.
Wields the mystical Star Rod to project energy blasts.

unknowns: Full extent of the Star Rod's power when separated from the Fountain of Dreams.
